name: codepartner-ai
description: A powerful agentic AI co-pilot with inline completions, planning, skills, browser control, and MCP support.

commands.title: CodePartner: Accept Patch Set (keep agent changes)
CodePartner: Reject Patch Set (rollback all files)

codepartner.apiKey.description: Deprecated: no longer used. API keys are stored securely via the "CodePartner: Set API Key" command instead of settings.json. Any value found here is migrated automatically and then cleared.
codepartner.apiKey.deprecationMessage: Deprecated — use the "CodePartner: Set API Key" command. Keys are no longer read from or stored in settings.

codepartner.completionModel.description: Optional faster/cheaper model for inline completions only. Empty = use codepartner.model (same as chat/agent).

enumDescriptions: Confirm every shell command, file edit/creation, and git commit/branch/PR before running it.
Only confirm shell commands. File edits and git operations run without a prompt.
Only confirm git commits, branches, and pull requests. Shell commands and file edits run without a prompt.
Full Auto — No Confirmations. Nothing prompts, ever (except actions flagged as possible prompt injection). Requires a one-time explicit confirmation to enable.
codepartner.approvalPolicy.description: Controls when CodePartner asks before running a shell command, writing a file, or making a git commit/branch/PR. Defaults to confirming everything.

codepartner.contextTokenBudget.description: Approximate token budget shared across per-turn file context (active editor content, other open tabs, @file mentions). Replaces the old fixed character caps on each source individually — content is truncated (on a line boundary) to fit within this shared budget instead.

enumDescriptions: @workspace uses TF-IDF (term-frequency ranked keyword search) only — the default, no extra API calls or cost.
Use real embeddings from whatever codepartner.provider is already configured. Falls back to TF-IDF if that's Anthropic (no embeddings endpoint).
Use OpenAI's embeddings API regardless of the chat provider.
Use Azure OpenAI's embeddings API regardless of the chat provider.
Use Google's embeddings API regardless of the chat provider.
Use a local Ollama embedding model — no API key needed.
codepartner.embeddingProvider.description: Upgrades @workspace search from TF-IDF to real embedding-based semantic search. Reuses the API key already set via "CodePartner: Set API Key" (Ollama needs none). On any failure (bad key, network error, unreachable endpoint) this automatically falls back to TF-IDF rather than breaking @workspace.

codepartner.embeddingModel.description: Embedding model name. Leave blank to use a sensible default for the selected codepartner.embeddingProvider (e.g. text-embedding-3-small for OpenAI, nomic-embed-text for Ollama).

codepartner.embeddingEndpoint.description: Custom embeddings API endpoint. Leave blank to use the provider's public default (or, for "same-as-chat", the same endpoint as codepartner.apiEndpoint).

enumDescriptions: Offer help only when a command fails in CodePartner's own visible terminal (started via run_in_terminal).
Offer help when a command fails in ANY terminal in the workspace, including ones you opened and typed into yourself. Requires a one-time confirmation the first time it's enabled.
codepartner.terminalInlineAssist.description: When a terminal command fails, shows a dismissable notification offering to ask CodePartner for help with the failure (the failed command + its output). "all-terminals" means CodePartner is watching everything typed into every terminal, not just its own — that's a real permission, not just a UI preference, hence the separate confirmation when you enable it.

codepartner.azureApiVersion.description: Azure OpenAI API version (only used when provider=azure)

codepartner.azureDeployments.description: List of Azure OpenAI deployment names to show in the dropdown.

codepartner.inlineCompletions.description: Enable inline code completions (ghost text). Uses API tokens on each keystroke (debounced).

codepartner.inlineCompletionDebounce.description: Debounce delay (ms) before triggering inline completion requests.

codepartner.llmNextEditSuggestions.description: Opt-in cost-capped LLM-assisted Next Edit Suggestions (in addition to local pattern detection). Uses chat provider tokens.

codepartner.nextEditSuggestions.description: Enable Next Edit Suggestions and Finish Changes (detect partial edits and offer to complete the same pattern elsewhere in the file).

codepartner.pluginCatalogRepo.description: Git URL of a plugin/agent catalog repo (cloned into extension storage). Agents under agents/ or .codepartner/agents/ are listed with list_custom_agents after sync.

codepartner.pluginCatalogBranch.description: Optional branch for pluginCatalogRepo (default: remote default).

codepartner.addAICoAuthor.description: Append a Co-authored-by trailer to commits made through CodePartner.

codepartner.mcpServers.description: MCP server configurations. Keys are server names, values are objects with 'command', 'args', 'env', and 'cwd' fields.

command.description: Command to start the MCP server.

codepartner.sandboxMode.description: Local agent sandbox: off (none), soft (command safety + filtered env), strict (also block network/install shell patterns; use bubblewrap on Linux when installed).

codepartner.autoVerify.description: After an agent turn that edits files, automatically run tests: off, focused (related test files), or full suite. Does not require the model to call run_tests.

codepartner.autoVerifyMaxAttempts.description: How many times auto-verify will re-run the same test command on failure (no model in the loop).

codepartner.reviewPacks.description: Static review policy packs applied after agent edit_file/create_file.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run check-types
